Train loss fell MONOTONICALLY every epoch with NO plateau: ep1 7.73e-4 -> ep2 8.41e-5 -> ep4 3.56e-5 -> ep6 1.49e-5 -> ep8 8.38e-6 (still dropping at the last epoch). (3) ONE KNOB: epochs 8 -> 40 (5x); EVERYTHING else identical to iter-1 (train_n=200, val_n=200, bs=2, lr=2e-4, uswin_c=24, swin_window=8, swin_heads=4, grad_clip=1.0, seed=42). (4) HYPOTHESIS: U-Swin is epochs-limited at ep8 on the 512px breast substrate; 5x more gradient steps drives the loss into its convergence basin and lifts hr from 0.649 toward/past the prior 256px champion 0.7174. TIMING: iter-1 = 8 epochs + 200-case val + figure in 190s. Even at a conservative ~15 s/epoch marginal cost the fixed overhead is ~190-8*15=70s, so 40 epochs = 70 + 40*15 = 670s = 11.2 min, well inside the 1200s wall (max_train_s=1000 backstop is the hard train-only guard, leaving room for the ~70s val+figure). FALSIFIER (NUMBERS): if hr plateaus at/below ~0.65 (or drops) at ep40, U-Swin is CAPACITY-limited at c24/win8/head4 -> iter-3 raises capacity (swin_window 8->16, the prior-champion lever for denser anatomy) rather than epochs. (5) HARD 20-min budget honored (670s predicted train+score, max_train_s=1000 backstop); val_n=200 = whole val pool. (6) I dispatch iter-3 myself when iter-2 lands.
